about: From power-on with nothing saved: the menus, Sonic in the character select with Ice Mountain Zone act 2 open, the course select down to Ice Mountain Zone act 2 and A on it, and the act's title card, all played in both; then at frame 2446 Sonic is put in the air over the act's special spring with the camera on it, as the start point puts the Dreamport's: he lands on it and rises into special stage 5, left alone to its end and its results, after which Ice Mountain Zone act 2 comes back with its title card and Sonic by the spring, left alone.
